description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller named UserController for managing user-related functionalities such as displaying a user form, saving, editing, deleting users, listing authorities, and changing passwords.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling user management operations such as form display, save, edit, delete, listing authorities, and changing passwords.

methods.name: showUserForm
methods.description: Displays the user form page with a new User object.

methods.name: saveUser
methods.description: Saves the user data received from the form.

methods.name: editUser
methods.description: Retrieves a user by ID and displays it in the form for editing.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Provides a list of authorities to the view.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Handles password change requests by verifying the old password and updating to a new password.
